notes: A casino lounge that is explicitly not playable is an environment to be in and looked at rather than won, which is Entertainment, and the Indoor Venue preset is exactly the museum-gallery-club case — one enclosed venue that is the whole map, so interior-single. I read 'purely decorative, not actually playable' as applying to the slot machines and card games rather than to traversal, so this is not a SET: players still walk the lounge floor. The seated card-playing NPCs are a stated request with a home in npc-population; the fixtures themselves — about 6 slot machines and 3 poker tables in classic red-velvet Vegas dressing, warm gold lighting, plush red seating and dark wood — ride along as free-text geometry with those counts, since no option ID covers them. I decided without asking that the lounge is entered at floor level with no separate exterior to generate, which keeps it off P3.
